captions.text: New books preserve 144 names after a village lost its future in seconds.
On 21 October 1966, a massive coal waste tip collapsed onto Aberfan.
116 children and 28 adults lost their lives in the disaster.
Will the National Library of Wales protect these pages?
Time wears down the original Aberfan Book of Remembrance, but fresh copies are needed.
The National Library of Wales finished new copies ahead of July 2026.
Aberfan Memorial Charity chair Davies guards the community's history now.
At 68 years old, Davies protects the village's memory.
144 names remain protected in fresh leather and ink.
